contracts.purpose: create a task-owned Sysblock model
contracts.return_contract: nonempty model handle/name; reject false or empty
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-model probe

contracts.purpose: open an existing loaded class
contracts.fallback: use model_manager load_file for an absolute file target

contracts.purpose: add a SysplorerEmbeddedCoder component
contracts.safe_probe: temporary model with a known built-in block
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-model probe

contracts.purpose: connect Sysblock ports
contracts.safe_probe: temporary two-block model; gripPoints contain bends only
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-model probe

contracts.purpose: set one block parameter
side_effects: changes model parameters and possibly variable ports
contracts.safe_probe: temporary model with a documented parameter
contracts.fallback: consult block-reference.md, then exact API documentation

contracts.purpose: read the complete parameter object for supported batch blocks
contracts.fallback: use ty-sysblock-batch-param-modeling rules

contracts.purpose: write a complete parameter object for supported batch blocks
contracts.safe_probe: temporary model only after a successful GetModelParamValues
contracts.fallback: use ty-sysblock-batch-param-modeling rules

contracts.purpose: route connections after placement is stable
contracts.fallback: adjust placement, then explicit bends for remaining violations

contracts.purpose: read back saved connection points
contracts.return_contract: Points returns a brace-form string {{x1,y1},{x2,y2},...}; parse it into a finite point list before geometry checks
contracts.fallback: read saved static annotation
contracts.source: Sysplorer 2026b exact Help plus live readback

contracts.purpose: read a component's documented type or other non-geometric property
contracts.return_contract: nonempty property-specific value; documented info types do not include Position
contracts.fallback: use the saved hash-bound Placement annotation for component frame geometry

contracts.purpose: save an existing model in place
side_effects: writes the confirmed current model file
contracts.fallback: stop and resolve model ownership/path

contracts.purpose: first save to a new target path
side_effects: creates a new model file; same-target overwrite is rejected
contracts.fallback: use SaveModel for an existing confirmed target

contracts.purpose: collect API failure diagnostics
contracts.fallback: preserve exception and direct API return

contracts.purpose: read the current Sysplorer working directory without changing it
contracts.fallback: session health path evidence plus targeted exact-name documentation lookup

contracts.purpose: get a StateMachine Chart block handle by model and component path
contracts.return_contract: positive integer Chart handle; zero is failure
contracts.fallback: stop if the exact Chart path does not return a positive handle

contracts.purpose: create Chart or State scoped data under a parent handle
side_effects: changes Chart data inventory and possibly exposed ports
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-Chart probe

contracts.purpose: read all documented properties of a Chart or Chart element
contracts.fallback: read individual required properties with GetChartElementInfo

contracts.purpose: read child Chart elements by optional type and depth
contracts.return_contract: list of child handles; empty is valid only when the expected inventory is empty
contracts.fallback: use exact child types State, Transition, Junction, ChartData, or ChartEvent

contracts.purpose: read component ports with an optional direction filter
contracts.return_contract: list of component port names; empty is also valid for a SysplorerEmbeddedCoder.Port.Outport boundary block in Sysplorer 2026b
contracts.fallback: use model_manager get_component_ports for the same exact component

contracts.purpose: create a StateMachine state
contracts.return_contract: positive integer state handle; set Name separately with SetChartElementInfo
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-Chart probe
contracts.source: state-machine.md; Sysplorer 2026b inspect.signature and function documentation

contracts.purpose: create a StateMachine transition
contracts.return_contract: positive integer transition handle; set Source and Destination separately with SetChartElementInfo
contracts.fallback: exact API documentation, then one disposable-Chart probe
contracts.source: state-machine.md; Sysplorer 2026b inspect.signature and function documentation

contracts.purpose: set StateMachine semantics or serialized geometry
contracts.safe_probe: one property on a disposable Chart element
contracts.fallback: use verified info_type tokens from state-machine.md

contracts.purpose: read one StateMachine property
contracts.fallback: GetChartElementInfos or saved annotation readback

contracts.purpose: load the exact saved target for final readback
contracts.return_contract: top-level load success and requested model present
contracts.fallback: stop on top-level load failure; ignore unrelated internal auto-load fragments only when model check passes

contracts.purpose: structural model check
side_effects: may update tool diagnostics; must not replace complete validation
contracts.fallback: collect named dependency/check errors

contracts.purpose: translate when required by task scope
contracts.safe_probe: not a capability probe; execute only when scope requires translation
contracts.fallback: stop and resolve translation errors

contracts.purpose: simulate when required by task scope
contracts.safe_probe: not a capability probe; execute only when scope requires simulation
contracts.fallback: stop and resolve simulation errors
